[SWS_CORE_00022] Semantics of a Corruption
⌈
A Corruption is the
consequence of the corruption of a system resource, e.g. stack or heap overflow, or a
hardware memory flaw (including even, for instance, a detected bit flip). A Corrup-
tion is non-recoverable.
⌋
